### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

## Summary

This issue tracks adoption and follow-up work for the shared JIT warmup infrastructure proposed in #47456.

## Foundation (blockers)

## Model-level de-JITification

### DeepSeek V4

### Gemma 4
- [x] https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55768
    - [ ] Enable `--jit-monitor-mode error` on CI for Gemma 4: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50109

### gpt-oss
- [ ] https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55769
    - [ ] Enable `--jit-monitor-mode error` on CI for gpt-oss: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50109

### GLM-5.2/5.3
- [ ] https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55348
    - [ ] Enable `--jit-monitor-mode error` on CI for GLM-5.2/5.3: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50109
    
### Kimi-K3
- [ ] https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54784
    - [ ] Enable `--jit-monitor-mode error` on CI for Kimi-K3: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50109

Complete model de-JITification is achieved when the model can run seamlessly with `--jit-monitor-mode error,` introduced in [#46167](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/46167). Enabling this mode in CI will detect any untracked kernels that still compile at runtime and therefore require additional warmup coverage.

```yaml
# Kimi-K3 decode on 8xB200 nodes.
#
# Cluster-agnostic: RDMA plumbing, node placement, and the node-local weight
# cache all come from a cluster overlay -- ../gke-b200 pulls in the same
# shared components as inkling-large does, so nothing in this file names a
# cluster. Without one there are no RDMA devices and DeepEP has no fabric for the
# inter-node all2all.
#
# Two 8xB200 nodes per group: TP=8 inside each node, DP=2 with hybrid LB across
# them, so the MoE runs EP=16 over DeepEP v2 on the RDMA fabric.
#
# Every pod runs the disagg routing sidecar on :8000 (the port the InferencePool
# targets); vLLM itself sits on :8200.
apiVersion: leaderworkerset.x-k8s.io/v1
kind: LeaderWorkerSet
metadata:
  name: kimi-k3-decode
  # These have to agree with the workerTemplate's labels below and with the
  # router's modelServers.matchLabels -- the overlays select on kind alone, but
  # the EPP finds pods by `llm-d.ai/guide`.
  labels:
    llm-d.ai/accelerator-variant: gpu
    llm-d.ai/accelerator-vendor: nvidia
    llm-d.ai/guide: kimi-k3-pd
    llm-d.ai/inference-serving: "true"
    llm-d.ai/model: kimi-k3
    llm-d.ai/role: decode
spec:
  replicas: 1
  startupPolicy: LeaderCreated
  leaderWorkerTemplate:
    # A group is two nodes doing EP=16 all2all every step: if one pod restarts,
    # the DP ranks have to re-form, so recreate the whole group.
    restartPolicy: RecreateGroupOnPodRestart
    size: 2
    workerTemplate:
      metadata:
        labels:
          llm-d.ai/guide: kimi-k3-pd
          llm-d.ai/inference-serving: "true"
          llm-d.ai/model: kimi-k3
          llm-d.ai/role: decode
      spec:
        # Node placement is per-cluster and comes from the overlay
        # (components/gke-placement).
        #
        # Native sidecar (initContainer + restartPolicy: Always): up before vLLM
        # and alive for the pod's life. Without that restartPolicy it would run
        # once, exit, and the pod would never reach the vLLM container.
        initContainers:
          - name: routing-proxy
            image: ghcr.io/llm-d/llm-d-router-disagg-sidecar:v0.9.0
            imagePullPolicy: Always
            restartPolicy: Always
            args:
              - --port=8000
              - --vllm-port=8200
              - --data-parallel-size=1
              - --kv-connector=nixlv2
              - --zap-log-level=1
              - --secure-proxy=false
            ports:
              - name: sidecar
                containerPort: 8000
                protocol: TCP
            securityContext:
              allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
              runAsNonRoot: true
        containers:
          - name: vllm
            # image: docker.io/vllm/vllm-openai:nightly
            image: public.ecr.aws/q9t5s3a7/vllm-ci-test-repo:b24e5a9cbeb1223ec76c21be7f9aa4571f6d24bf
            imagePullPolicy: Always
            command:
              - /bin/bash
              - -c
            args:
              - |-
                set -euo pipefail

                DP_SIZE=$(( ${LWS_GROUP_SIZE:-1} * DP_SIZE_LOCAL ))
                START_RANK=$(( ${LWS_WORKER_INDEX:-0} * DP_SIZE_LOCAL ))

                # Each step proposes SPEC_TOKENS MTP drafts plus the verified
                # token, so a full batch of MAX_SEQS needs (SPEC_TOKENS+1)x the
                # token budget. Keep this tied to SPEC_TOKENS, not hardcoded.
                MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS=$(( MAX_SEQS * (SPEC_TOKENS + 1) ))

                export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
                export VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS
                export VLLM_DEEPEP_V2_ALLOW_HYBRID_MODE=1
                export VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL=0

                export NCCL_GIN_TYPE=3
                export VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT=1

                # --- image gap-fillers -------------------------------------
                # The images we run here do not ship NIXL yet, and the P/D KV
                # transfer needs it. Set BOOTSTRAP_NIXL=0 once the image does.
                if [[ "${BOOTSTRAP_NIXL}" == "1" ]]; then
                  (uv pip install --system nixl nixl-cu13 \
                    || pip install --no-cache-dir nixl nixl-cu13)
                fi

                # The image also has no `ibstat` (infiniband-diags), so the RDMA
                # link-speed probe logs "Failed to get RDMA connection speed" on
                # every worker. Cosmetic -- the verbs path does not go through
                # ibstat -- but it is a ~2MB package. Non-fatal so a cluster
                # without apt egress still starts. Set BOOTSTRAP_IB_DIAGS=0 once
                # the image ships it.
                if [[ "${BOOTSTRAP_IB_DIAGS}" == "1" ]] && ! command -v ibstat >/dev/null; then
                  (apt-get update -qq \
                    && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends infiniband-diags) \
                    || echo "WARN: infiniband-diags install failed; ibstat stays missing"
                fi

                unset VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK
                exec vllm serve "${MODEL}" \
                  --port 8200 \
                  --trust-remote-code \
                  --disable-access-log-for-endpoints=/health,/metrics \
                  --enable-prefix-caching \
                  --enable-expert-parallel \
                  --tensor-parallel-size $TP_SIZE \
                  --max-num-batched-tokens "${MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS}" \
                  --max-num-seqs "${MAX_SEQS}" \
                  --speculative-config "{\"model\":\"RedHatAI/Kimi-K3-speculator.dspark\",\"method\":\"dspark\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":${SPEC_TOKENS},\"draft_sample_method\":\"probabilistic\",\"rejection_sample_method\":\"block\"}" \
                  --data-parallel-hybrid-lb \
                  --data-parallel-size "${DP_SIZE}" \
                  --data-parallel-size-local "${DP_SIZE_LOCAL}" \
                  --data-parallel-address "${LWS_LEADER_ADDRESS}" \
                  --data-parallel-rpc-port 5555 \
                  --data-parallel-start-rank "${START_RANK}" \
                  --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
                  --all2all-backend deepep_v2 \
                  --moe-backend auto \
                  --max-cudagraph-capture-size "${MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS}" \
                  --kv_transfer_config '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector",
                        "kv_role":"kv_consumer",
                        "kv_load_failure_policy":"fail"}' \
                  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
                  --attention-config '{"use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"mla_prefill_backend":"flashinfer"}' \
                  --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune

            env:
              - name: MODEL
                value: moonshotai/Kimi-K3
              - name: TP_SIZE
                value: "8"
              - name: DP_SIZE_LOCAL
                value: "1"
              - name: MAX_SEQS
                value: "32"
              - name: SPEC_TOKENS
                value: "3"
              - name: BOOTSTRAP_NIXL
                value: "1"
              - name: BOOTSTRAP_IB_DIAGS
                value: "1"
              - name: HF_TOKEN
                valueFrom:
                  secretKeyRef:
                    name: llm-d-hf-token
                    key: HF_TOKEN
              - name: VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S
                value: "3000"
              - name: VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE
                value: "120"
              - name: VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL
                value: INFO
              - name: VLLM_SKIP_P2P_CHECK
                value: "1"
              - name: VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS
                value: "1"
              - name: VLLM_RANDOMIZE_DP_DUMMY_INPUTS
                value: "1"
              - name: TRITON_LIBCUDA_PATH
                value: /usr/local/nvidia/lib64
              - name: TORCH_CPP_LOG_LEVEL
                value: ERROR
              - name: NVIDIA_GDRCOPY
                value: enabled
              - name: NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT
                value: ibgda
              - name: NVSHMEM_IB_ENABLE_IBGDA
                value: "true"
              - name: NVSHMEM_DISABLE_DMABUF
                value: "0"
              - name: NVSHMEM_BOOTSTRAP_UID_SOCK_IFNAME
                value: eth0
              - name: GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME
                value: eth0
              - name: NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME
                value: eth0
              - name: NCCL_TUNER_PLUGIN
                value: none
              - name: NCCL_NET_PLUGIN
                value: ""
              - name: VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST
                valueFrom:
                  fieldRef:
                    fieldPath: status.podIP
              - name: HF_HUB_CACHE
                value: /var/cache/huggingface
              - name: VLLM_CACHE_ROOT
                value: /var/cache/vllm/vllm
              - name: FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE
                value: /var/cache/vllm/flashinfer
              - name: CUDA_CACHE_PATH
                value: /var/cache/vllm/cuda
              - name: DO_NOT_TRACK
                value: "1"
            ports:
              - name: modelserver
                containerPort: 8200
                protocol: TCP
            # RDMA extended resources come from the overlay
            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: "32"
                memory: 512Gi
                ephemeral-storage: 1Ti
                nvidia.com/gpu: "8"
              limits:
                memory: 512Gi
                ephemeral-storage: 1Ti
                nvidia.com/gpu: "8"
            securityContext:
              privileged: true
              runAsUser: 0
              runAsGroup: 0
              capabilities:
                add:
                  - IPC_LOCK
                  - SYS_RAWIO
            volumeMounts:
              - name: dshm
                mountPath: /dev/shm
              - name: hf-cache
                mountPath: /var/cache/huggingface
              - name: jit-cache
                mountPath: /var/cache/vllm
            # Probes target vLLM on :8200, not the sidecar -- pod readiness
            # should track the engine, which is the thing that can be slow.
            startupProbe:
              httpGet:
                path: /health
                port: modelserver
              initialDelaySeconds: 0
              periodSeconds: 1
              timeoutSeconds: 5
              failureThreshold: 2700
            readinessProbe:
              httpGet:
                path: /health
                port: modelserver
              periodSeconds: 10
              timeoutSeconds: 5
              failureThreshold: 3
            livenessProbe:
              httpGet:
                path: /health
                port: modelserver
              periodSeconds: 30
              timeoutSeconds: 5
              failureThreshold: 3
        volumes:
          - name: dshm
            emptyDir:
              medium: Memory
              sizeLimit: 8Gi
          - name: hf-cache
            emptyDir: {}
          - name: jit-cache
            emptyDir: {}

```

Following the DSPARK report above, I ran a separate focused probe for inference-time Triton JITs on the hybrid Mamba align path.

In a broader Granite run I also observed `_causal_conv1d_fwd_kernel`, consistent with the report above. The focused investigation below isolates a different kernel: `batch_memcpy_kernel`.

Environment:

- current main: `e0e5a7f`
- RTX 4090 (sm89)
- `ibm-granite/granite-4.0-tiny-preview` config with dummy weights
- fresh Triton and vLLM caches
- JIT monitor in warn + verbose mode

The first runtime compilation occurs exactly when the prompt crosses the default 16-token block boundary:

- prompt lengths 8, 15, and 16: no `batch_memcpy_kernel` JIT
- prompt length 17: first runtime JIT
- later lengths in the same process reuse that compiled specialization

The warning reports one fixed specialization:

```text
Triton kernel JIT compilation during inference: batch_memcpy_kernel
(constexprs={BLOCK_SIZE=1024};
signature={src_ptrs='*u64', dst_ptrs='*u64', sizes='*i32'})
```

I built a focused prototype using the shared registry introduced by #50174:

- route the runtime call through a `VllmJitKernel` singleton
- compile the `*u64, *u64, *i32, BLOCK_SIZE=1024` specialization using compile-only `TritonWarmupTensor` descriptors
- register it while `GPUModelRunner.jit_warmup_registry` is active when `mamba_cache_mode == "align"`
- keep runtime dispatch and warmup dispatch on the same compile key

Registration timing matters here. Registering from the lazily created `MambaCopyBuffers` is too late: startup still contains only one compile key and the 17-token request still triggers the runtime JIT. Registering during the active `GPUModelRunner` setup produces the expected result:

| Configuration | Startup compile keys | Runtime `batch_memcpy_kernel` JIT |
|---|---:|---:|
| Before active-registry registration | 1 | 1 at prompt length 17 |
| With active-registry registration | 2 | 0 |

With fresh caches, the updated path completed prompt lengths 8, 15, 16, 17, 24, 30, and 31 without another runtime compilation of this kernel. The focused migration test file passes (`6 passed`), and Ruff lint/format plus `git diff --check` are clean.

I have the focused probe harness and full before/after logs available if useful. If this matches the intended direction for #49349, I am happy to adjust the prototype, provide additional coverage, or continue the investigation wherever it would be most useful.

I reproduced another remaining inference-time JIT on current `main` (`d9dabfa351acdb4ceaad18c9677bc7a08b6c04ea`) in the Qwen3.5 GDN output-projection path:

```text

ACTIVATION='silu', BLOCK_N=128, HAS_BIAS=False, HAS_Z=True,
IS_RMS_NORM=True, N=128, NORM_BEFORE_GATE=True, ROWS_PER_BLOCK=4
X/Y/W/Z='*bf16'
```

Environment: `Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B`, RTX 3090 (sm86), fresh Triton/vLLM caches, JIT monitor enabled before the first real request. The call is on the normal generation path:

`QwenGatedDeltaNet._output_projection` -> `RMSNormGated.forward_cuda` -> `layer_norm_fwd_kernel`.

A naive dummy launch is insufficient: it compiled `ROWS_PER_BLOCK=1`, while the real request required `4`. I found no open PR that migrates this kernel to the shared warmup contract; #51134 only removes an obsolete FlashInfer startup message.

I am taking the focused Qwen GDN subtask: route runtime and compile-only warmup through the same `VllmJitKernel` dispatch contract, cover the possible `ROWS_PER_BLOCK` specializations, and validate with cold caches plus `--jit-monitor-mode error`. I will keep the change scoped to this kernel/path and post the PR here once the exact diff has been reviewed and the focused tests pass.
